fnol_text: My name is Anika Novak and I live at 184 Foxglove Way, Riverton, WY 82583. You can reach me on (555) 362-2687 or anika.novak@example.com. Our house was built two years ago and cracks have appeared in the plaster; on 17 February 2025 we had a builder look and he says it is the new house settling. Policy HH-2024-00115. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Novak on (555) 362-2687 to acknowledge the claim. Anika confirmed the loss date as 17 February 2025.
Site visit to 184 Foxglove Way. Neighbour Marcus Chukwu was present and confirmed the timeline.
